title: Limiting maximum and minimum of st.date_input's selectable dates to the maximum/minimum of datetime.datetime
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Setting the maximum available value of Python's datetime as default for st.date_input causes issues.
The function internally tries to set a value 10 years later for the selection widget and then crashes.

To reproduce the behaviour, run this code: 
```
import streamlit as st
from datetime import datetime
st.date_input('Enter Timespan:', value=[datetime.today() , datetime.max])
```
The documentation for st.date_input includes a parameter to control the maximum value of the selection widget: 
> max_value : datetime.date or datetime.datetime
>     The maximum selectable date. If value is a date, defaults to value + 10 years.
>     If value is the interval [start, end], defaults to end + 10 years.

Setting the parameter max_value of st.date_input to datetime.max solves the issue.
`st.date_input('Enter Date:',  max_value=datetime.max, value=[datetime.today(), datetime.max])`

### Why?

This result is expected behaviour and can be inferred from the documentation. 
However, it seems rather inelegant/unintuitive to explicitly have to set an additional max_value when using the maximum value of the data type used.

### How?

Since date_input works with datetime internally, I'd set it to check datetime.max (and datetime.min, similarily) itself and not try to set its maximum to an impossible value.  
So to get the max selectable value in pseudocode would be:
```
max_value = max( value + 10 years, datetime.max)
```

If this behaviour is not desired, a nicer warning would be in order. 
```
Error message: 
ValueError: year 10009 is out of range
```
Took me a while to trace that back to streamlit internally adding 10 years. Maybe something like:
```
ValueError: Cannot set value 9999. Default value range for date_input [9989-10009] would be out of range for datetime. Please set max_value.
```
